# Vyapar Sanket by Layr0 Labs

Vyapar Sanket is an Android app for receiving partner signals and managing related orders through the user's supported broker setup. Handling is configured per topic. Manual mode asks for a decision. Automatic mode can act on eligible opening signals. Closing a position requires review and confirmation.

Website: https://vyaparsanket.layr0.org/
Install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.sales4radii.indiancrossTrader
Registration: https://youtu.be/GCFPUApT26I
Connector documentation: https://docs.layr0.org/docs/products/imc
Privacy: https://layr0.org/console/privacy-policy
Support: adysenlab@gmail.com

The browser sandbox demonstrates short-term and long-term sample rules with local simulated orders. It requires no account. The Android gallery contains reviewed, sanitized views of Home, Trades and Profile from version 1.0.5 (build 42).

The Research360 historical table covers March through October 2026. Gross signal returns sum closed-trade returns in the segment by exit month. Account returns depend on actual execution, costs and capital allocation. Trading involves risk of loss.
